excerpts.content:
👋  ETHOnline (https://ethonline.org) Kickoff Summit starts in 1 hour! We'll be covering everything you need to know about the hackathon at the beginning of the event and then moving into our talks and panels for the day.

→ Join the community at https://live.ethonline.org at 12 PM ET October 2nd

Here's the schedule for today:

12:00 ET  🚀  Welcome and Introduction w/ Kartik Talwar
12:30 ET  🚀  Rediscovering Ethereum's Opportunities w/ Aya Miyaguchi
13:30 ET  🚀  Eth1 + Eth2 = Ethereum w/ <@!291925846556540928> 
14:00 ET  💻  Test-driven live coding of AMM market with Waffle + Buidler w/ Marek Kirejczyk and Bartek Rutkowski
14:30 ET  💻  Introducing the Ethereum.org Dev Portal w/ Sam Richards and Ryan Cordell
15:15 ET  🚀  Intro to DeFi w/ Mariano Conti
16:00 ET  🚀  Ethereum is for artists w/ André Anjos (RAC), Dee Goens, and Jacob Horne
16:30 ET  🚀  Defi 2.0: Community Owned & Meme Based w/ Camila Russo
17:00 ET  💻  A Remix Drive Thru w/ Rob Stupay & Iuri Matias
17:30 ET  🚀  Dark Forest: Challenges and Constraints in ZK Gaming w/ Brian Gu
19:00 ET  🚀  Scaling Ethereum in 2020 and Beyond w/ <@!273808422753796097> 

We can't wait for the fun to start - remember, this is the first Summit of 5:

Oct 9 - Scaling and Infrastructure
Oct 16 - Decentralized Finance
Oct 23 - The Future of Ethereum
Oct 30 - Ethereum's Impact & Finale

We hope you will join us throughout October to celebrate Ethereum in 2020!
